senses.gloss:
Kṛpaṇamāyāsaṃvāda
Jhalrapatan p. 74.

Kṛpaṇaśreṣṭhikathā
Jain. on dāna included in Dvādaśakathā. Pattan I. p. 35.

Kṛpaṇākrandanastotra
by Jagaddhara Bhaṭṭa.
Pt.. with Laghupañcikā of Ratnakaṇṭha. K. M. 23, p.. 105-135.

Kṛpākaṭākṣabhājana
stotra on Rādhā. RASB. VII. 5565 (XVI). [Page282-a.

Kṛpācārya
Nimbārka teacher, successor of Gopālācārya, predecessor of Devācārya; 12th from Nimbārka. See Bhr. p. 212, Ācāryanavaratnamālā stava.

Kṛpānātha
--C. on Bhāskara's Līlāvatī. See Gaṇakataraṅgiṇī p. 37. Mistake for Kṛpārāma ?

Kṛpānātha_vācaspati
teacher of Rāmanātha Vidyālaṅkāra (a. of C. s on Dāya an. Śuddhi Kaumudīs) of Kāmarūpa; born, 1871 A. D.
See J. of Gauhati Uni. XV. i. Arts. 1965, p. 88.

Kṛpāpaddhati
jy. written in 1814 A. D. by Devakīnandana Daivajña, son an. student of Jīvānanda Daivajña an. grandson of Lakṣmīdhara of Āṅgirasa Gotra.
Alwar 1728. Extr. 459. Stein 157.

Kṛpāpātra
--Kevalādvaitavādakuliśa. BORI. 411 of 1875-76. Report XXVII.

Kṛpārasakośa
Jain. by Śānticandra Upādhyāya; panegyric on Akbar; written a. the instance of Hīravijaya Sūri; on hearing this, Akbar gave some exemptions an. permissions to a. See Intro. p. 8, 28 fn. Bhānucandragaṇicaritra, Singhi Jain Ser. 15; also Hīrasaubhāgyakāvya, ch. 14, verses 270 an. 271.
Chani 428.
Pt.. Pravartaka Śrī Kāntivijaya Jaina Itihāsa Mālā 2, Bhavnagar, 1916-17.
--C. by Ratnacandragaṇi.
See BORI. D. XVIII. i. 82.

Kṛpārāma,_rājaº
of Gauḍakṣatrakula; descendant of Māṇikyacandra an. son of Yādavarāja; a Gond chieftain who ruled over [Page282-b] a kingdom near Agra; feudatory of Jahangir an. Shah Jehan; praised in Kāvyavilāsa (Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts 16, p. 18) of Cirañjīva Bhaṭṭa, son of Rāghavendra, styled Śatāvadhāna Bhaṭṭācārya, who wrote in his (Kṛpārāma's) name:
--Rāmaprakāśa or Kālatattvārṇavasetu. dh. IO. 1600-1602, written in 1647 A. D. a. Indurakhī in Gwalior.
Mentioned also in Vidvanmodataraṅgiṇī of Cirañjīvi Bhaṭṭa.
See also IHQ. XVII. p.. 1-10.
--C. Rāmaprakāśa on Rāmacandra's Kālanirṇayadīpikā. IO. 1664-66.
Kṛpārāma's son Yaśvantasiṁha is eulogised in the illustrative verses of the Vṛttaratnāvali of Cirañjīvi Bhaṭṭācārya, son of Rāghavendra.
See JASB(NS) XI (1915) p. 291.

Kṛpārāma
--Kārakārtha. Udaipur II. 163, 7.
--C. on Kṛṣṇasvarūpāvirbhāva. Udaipur II. 133, 36.
--C. on Ṣaṭpadī. Udaipur II. 133, 37.

Kṛpārāma
father of Navanītarāma, a. of C. on Kumārasambhava. Mithilā II. iii. 28.

Kṛpārāma
--Nityakarmaprakāśa (compiled).
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1365.

Kṛpārāma
--Rūpadīpa. BORI. 1465 of 1887-91.

Kṛpārāma
--Kāśīmāhātmyasaṅgraha. dh. NW. 444.

Kṛpārāma
--Mudrāprakāśa. on Haṭhayoga. NW. 424.

Kṛpārāma
--Vāstucandrikā. dh. NW. 174. [Page283-a.
The following Kṛpārāmas who have written on jy. are probably identical.

Kṛpārāma
--C. Jātakabhūṣaṇa on Jātakālaṅkāra of Gaṇeśa. IM. 1401 (with text). Mithilā III. 106-8 (a..). Ujjain II. p. 45.

Kṛpārāma
--C. on Mahādeva's Pañcapakṣī. NW. 562.

Kṛpārāma
--Makarandakārikā. jy. in 81 Kārikās; composed in 1815 A. D. based on Sūryasiddhānta; on preparation of the calender. RASB. X. 6892.

Kṛpārāma
--Makarandodāharaṇa. NP. I. 142. NW. 548. PUL. II. p. 230.

Kṛpārāma
--C. Ṭīkā on Muhūrtatattva of Keśava Daivajña. NW. 546.

Kṛpārāma
--C. on Sarvārthacintāmaṇi. jy. NP. II. 74. NW. 512. Trav. Uni. 1284.

Kṛpārāma_miśra
--C. Udāharaṇa on Cakradhara's Yantracintāmaṇi. NW. 558.

Kṛpārāma_udāsī
son of Dīvāna Siṁha; pupil of Rāmadayāla, of Nānaka's line.
--Śivagītā an. C. Sugamā. RASB. VII. 5631.
The verse after Maṅgala states that the C. was written a. the instance of a Brahmin, probably Paramasukha by name, residing in Benares.

Kṛpārāma_tarkavāgīśa
of the Mukhavaṁśa, patronised by Kṛṣṇacandra of Nadia; pupil of Jayarāma. Probably same a. one of that name among the 11 Pandits [Page283-b] employed by Warren Hastings for compiling the Vivādārṇavasetu an. Vivādārṇavabhaṅga.
See also Hpr. IV. Preface xiv.
--Aṅkādarśa. gaṇita. Hpr. IV. 3.
--Navyadharmapradīpa written in 1764-5 A. D. on dh. a. followed by Gauḍas. Hpr. II. 113. RASB. III. 2223. SK. Ray D.. 65.
See Sāhitya Pariṣat Patrikā Vol. 47, p. 47; J. of the G. Jhā Res. Inst. I. iv. p. 307.

Kṛpārāma_daivajña,_miśra
son of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa Miśra of Bhāradvājagotra, a Gurjara Moḍha Brāhmaṇa an. inhabitant of Ahmedabad; pupil of Lakṣmīnātha.
--C. Bālabodhinī or Udāharaṇa on the Bījagaṇita of Bhāskara, composed in 1792 A. D.
Alwar 1869. Extr. 528. C.. IX. 72. IO. 2833. Mithilā III. 211.

Kṛpārāmaśarman
--C. Nyāyabodhinī on Tarkasaṅgraha of Annam Bhaṭṭa.
Pt.. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1365.

Kṛpālapaṇḍita
--Kātantrakaumudī. R. A. Sastri I. p. 45.

Kṛpālukṛṣṇa
teacher of Nārāyaṇa, of Toṇḍamūla (?) (a. of Komaleśamālā stotra).
See NCC. III. p. 168b.

Kṛpāludattaśarman
disciple of Nandarāma Śarman an. father of Sudhākara Dvivedin (a. of Gaṇakataraṅgiṇī). See Gaṇakataraṅgiṇī p. 125.

Kṛpāvijaya
teacher of Meghavijaya (1650-1705 A. D.), a. of the Pañcākhyānoddhāra, IO. 7313; of C. Śabdacandrikā on Hemacandra's Śabdānuśāsana, Adyar [Page284-a. D. II. 693, an. of Hastājīvana BORI. ms. See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p.. 87, 91.

Kṛpāvijaya
--Candrārkīvṛtti. Jain. jy.
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. IV. ii. p. 114.

Kṛpāśaṅkara
son of Chājū(bū)rāma.
--Jyotiṣakedāra, composed in 1762-3 A. D. Bik. 655. BORI. 486 of 1892-95 (Puṣpoccaya from). Oudh XVI. 76.

Kṛpāśaṅkara
--Nītiviveka. dh. NW. 110.
See Dayāśaṅkara.

Kṛpāśaṅkara
--Putrapradastotra. IM. 9469 (inc.).

Kṛpāśaṅkaraśarman
--Tithinirṇayamañjūṣā.
Pt.. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1365.

Kṛpāsāgarastava
stotra. in 10 verses. by one who salutes Śrīnidhi an. Raṅganātha Yatis. Adyar I. p. 178b. Adyar D. IV. 1450.
